name: Awesome Hyprland
summary: Community list of Hyprland plugins, tools, bars and dotfiles.
description: The community-maintained list of tools for Hyprland: language bindings for its IPC, config editors and language servers, plugins (touch gestures, extra tiling layouts, per-monitor workspaces), bars, widgets and more. A good place to look once you know which part of your setup you want to change.
